hero2.titlePart2: 35 countries, 4 tiers — let AI filter first, then decide together
hero2.description: Qihuang Sihai is the go-global decision partner for TCM, supplement and Hanfang skincare brands. AI filters 35 countries into 4 priority tiers in three minutes; our senior advisors then decide with you — whether to go, when to go, and how.
hero2.dq2: Are budget, team and product ready?
hero2.dq3: Drug, food or cosmetics — which pathway?
hero2.dq4: Japan, EU or SE Asia — which first?
hero2.trust2: Covers market, compliance, cost, channel and risk
hero2.trust3: Complex projects escalated to senior advisors
hero2.q1c: Advisor, our boss wants to go all-in on the Japanese market next year. Should we take this step now?
hero2.q1a: Don't lock in Japan yet. Regulatory complexity varies 3–5x across our 35 markets, so the AI diagnosis will give you a priority ranking first — rather than letting you pick a destination outright.
hero2.q2c: We have an OTC Chinese patent medicine and want to enter the EU and Southeast Asia. We've heard EU THR takes at least 18 months — we can't afford that.
hero2.q2a: True — the EU traditional herbal route is not a "big investment first" path. I'll spend 30 minutes breaking it down for you: this should be a goal for after 12 months, not a Q1 launch.
hero2.q3c: We've always done OTC. Now we want functional food + Hanfang skincare, but we don't know which category positioning to choose.
hero2.q3a: Category choice itself determines your registration pathway, channels, and marketing language. The AI diagnosis will first make a call on category positioning, then a human advisor will verify it with you.
hero2.advisorQuote: I'm not selling you a report. I'm here to make the market-entry decision together — until you dare to sign.
hero2.advisorBio: Over the past 12 years, I've walked 60+ TCM companies through all three stages: project kickoff, market entry, and review. If the path is picked wrong even once, we'll spend 30 minutes switching it. If the product shouldn't be built, we'll tell you straight.

about2.dataParagraph: The most expensive mistake in going global isn't the money — it's that one wrong step. We won't let you rely on gut instinct. We've turned the 35-country regulatory frameworks, ten thousand candidates, and nearly a hundred real cases into a data backbone you can touch. Then AI points the way, data grounds the foundation, and senior advisors walk with you — so every step is steady.
about2.whyStableP1: Going global isn't rushing — it's walking steadily. One wrong step costs you the next 12 months. We've seen it too many times.
about2.whyStableP2: I once watched an old TCM doctor fly to Japan alone to study the market — then sit still for six months. Not because he lacked drive, but because he didn't know who to ask next, afraid of taking one more wrong step.
about2.whyStableP3: We built Little Tuo to answer that very question: who should you ask next? A person you can find, online 24/7 — Little Tuo scans the data, senior advisors help you judge, and you focus on what only you can do.
about2.whyStableP4: The difference isn't resources. It's whether someone steadies each step for you.
about2.whyStableP5: That's why we built Qihuang Sihai — so that when you go global, someone stands behind you, Little Tuo stands beside you, and the road beneath your feet is steady.
about2.founderQuote: We didn't build this to give the industry one more option. We built it so every Bencao brand ready to go global can step out into the world — steadily.
about2.teammoteQuote: I'm Little Tuo, Zhang Xiaoqiang's colleague. Online around the clock, scanning directions, checking regulations, reading the numbers — the teammate who never sleeps, walking steadily beside you.

about2.whoQuote: Going global isn't a slogan — it's a road you must walk steadily, every single step.

countryAssessment.pageTitle: Export Target Country Assessment · Qihuang Sihai
countryAssessment.footerResult: The above is computed by the local rule engine; after submission the configuration is sent to the backend for follow-up.
countryAssessment.needCountry: Please select at least 1 candidate country
countryAssessment.countriesTitle: Select Candidate Countries and Entry Assumptions
countryAssessment.countriesSubtitle: Select at least 1 country, up to 5. Each country has its own entry mode; the next step asks you to score each dimension and set hard-gate status.
countryAssessment.entryModeTitle: Choose an entry mode for each candidate country
countryAssessment.entryModeHint: Fit hints will appear once you choose an entry mode
countryAssessment.notesPh: Market assumptions / customer leads / outreach progress (optional)
countryAssessment.tooMany: Too many candidate countries dilute the distinction. We suggest focusing on the 3–5 countries with the best odds.
countryAssessment.evidenceNoCountries: Please select at least 1 candidate country before entering scores and hard gates.
countryAssessment.evidenceTitle: Enter scores, evidence, and hard gates for each country
countryAssessment.evidenceSubtitle: Scores answer "can this market work"; evidence grade answers "how much evidence backs the score"; hard-gate status answers "must we decide right now whether to proceed".
countryAssessment.noRequiredGate: This template has no mandatory hard gates. We recommend at least manually confirming sanctions and licensing.
countryAssessment.evidenceNote: The lower the evidence grade, the more the score automatically shrinks toward a neutral value
countryAssessment.modelSubtitle: Start from a business-model template, then fine-tune the weights for your specific capabilities (must total 100%).
countryAssessment.hardGates: Hard Gates (triggering any one stops the assessment)
countryAssessment.hardGatesHint: "Must confirm" asks the user to mark status for this country at the next step; "Skip for now" temporarily removes it from the hard-gate set.
countryAssessment.profileSubtitle: Start by stating the export question clearly: business, product, time window, and the risk you can carry. The answers here anchor every score and recommendation that follows.
countryAssessment.fieldProductHint: Include target customers, key selling points, average order value, and certifications; this affects country scoring below.
countryAssessment.fieldProductPh: e.g. Health food based on a classic TCM formula, focused on liver support and immunity, targeting 30–55-year-old high-net-worth customers, average order value 600 RMB, GMP and ISO22000 certified.
countryAssessment.fieldWindowHint: Describe the time window you want to enter candidate countries, e.g. "the next 18 months" or "H1 2026".
countryAssessment.readinessHint: Score 1–5 across 6 readiness dimensions. This measures "can we execute well", kept separate from the country opportunity score (can the market work).
countryAssessment.submitOk: Submitted. We will contact you shortly.
countryAssessment.resultNoCountries: Please go back and select at least 1 candidate country before generating results.
countryAssessment.resultTitle: Country Assessment Results and Next Actions
countryAssessment.resultSubtitle: The number reflects "can this market work" × evidence confidence; the conclusion reflects "can we do this now". Any triggered hard gate immediately overrides the floor and is flagged red, and cannot be offset by the score.
countryAssessment.rankTitle: Candidate Countries Ranked by Adjusted Score
countryAssessment.aiHint: Generates a Chinese explanation, a 90–180 day validation order, and a counter-argument from the structured results; when AI is unavailable only the rule-engine result is shown.
countryAssessment.submitTitle: Connect This Assessment with Your Team
countryAssessment.submitHint: The information below is written into the existing customer record so staff can follow up immediately; if left blank it will not be saved.
countryAssessment.contactEmailPh: Optional, used to send the assessment report
countryAssessment.contactNotePh: We are most interested in connecting 2 countries, with an expected time window of 18 months
countryAssessment.consent: I agree to submit the above assessment results and form content to the Zhang Xiaoqiang Consulting team for assessment follow-up; AI explanations will not be shared with third parties.
countryAssessment.cardProfileHint: Weights calibrated to the business model
countryAssessment.cardWeightBad: Needs normalization or freezing the current allocation
countryAssessment.cardCountriesHint: Triggered hard gates set the floor but are not deleted
countryAssessment.weightBreakdown: View this country's weight and score breakdown
countryAssessment.disclosureTitle: View the Full Assessment Inputs and Criteria
countryAssessment.aiFallback: AI is unavailable; fell back to the rule-engine conclusion.
